facebook.content:
Family—strengthening the bonds God designed.  
Lord, we declare that every home under Your name walks in unity, love, and divine purpose. May Your peace rule each heart, forgiveness flow freely, and the Spirit of wisdom guide every decision. We command discord to flee and righteousness to reign in every household.  

If you stand with this declaration, drop a 🙏. Have a prayer need? Share it below.

instagram.content:
Family—Guard the foundation God has set.  
Our homes are under attack; the enemy seeks division, yet the Shepherd calls us to unity in Christ.  

Father, we decree that every household under our care walks in the peace of Psalm 133, that love reigns, and every word spoken builds the Kingdom. We stand firm in Your covenant.  

Drop 🙏 if you stand with us, or type your prayer request below.
